input_text: On the issue of the defendant's guilt, Alex told the jury that he believed the defendant was guilty.

extraction.input_text: On the issue of the defendant's guilt, Alex told the jury that he believed the defendant was guilty.

claim.text: Is the statement described in this narrative hearsay under FRE 801(c)?

arguments.text: The statement was made in court to the jury, not out of court, failing the threshold requirement for hearsay under FRE 801(c).
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) requires a statement made by a declarant while testifying at the current trial or hearing to be excluded from the hearsay definition; only out-of-court statements qualify.

arguments.text: The statement contains a clear assertion of fact regarding the declarant's belief about the defendant's guilt.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c)(1) defines hearsay as a statement that the declarant asserts.
arguments.evidence_span: that he believed the defendant was guilty

arguments.text: The statement is offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted, specifically the defendant's guilt.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c)(3) requires the statement to be offered in evidence to prove the truth of the matter asserted.
arguments.evidence_span: On the issue of the defendant's guilt
